breaking_news.headline: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
breaking_news.summary: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

breaking_news.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

breaking_news.headline: A negative Outlook: Microsoft scrambles to fix email outage
breaking_news.summary: Early Friday, after Outlook had been down for more than 12 hours, Microsoft reported "marginal success."

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
breaking_news.summary: As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.

breaking_news.headline: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
breaking_news.summary: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

breaking_news.headline: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.

breaking_news.headline: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short
breaking_news.summary: A pair economists argue in a new book that people are more creative and productive when they work together in person. But it's not enough for employers to simply order workers back to the office.

breaking_news.headline: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.

breaking_news.headline: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 17 dead
breaking_news.summary: The shootings in KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng highlight South Africa's struggle to curb violent crime.

breaking_news.headline: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial next year for deaths of her three children
breaking_news.summary: The 36-year-old's first trial this year fell apart when a 12-person jury failed to reach a verdict.

breaking_news.headline: Forensic expert says his analysis raises doubts about how Epstein died
breaking_news.summary: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

breaking_news.headline: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
breaking_news.summary: Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, becoming the seventh actor to take up the mantle of 007.

breaking_news.headline: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
breaking_news.summary: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

breaking_news.headline: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
breaking_news.summary: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

breaking_news.headline: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
breaking_news.summary: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

breaking_news.headline: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
breaking_news.summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

breaking_news.headline: Beauty advent calendars can cost hundreds but are they value for money?
breaking_news.summary: Beauty calendars have become a Christmas staple and have become particularly popular with female shoppers.

breaking_news.headline: Avoid this Black Friday scam - how to check it's a real deal
breaking_news.summary: Sales and the looming tax deadline mean more scams - here's how to make sure you don't get caught out.

breaking_news.headline: Gas starts flowing from Jackdaw after government green light
breaking_news.summary: Ministers last month announced the Jackdaw gas field, which lies 150 miles east of Aberdeen, had been approved after years of uncertainty.

breaking_news.headline: Intel sued by investors after PC sales slump hits share price
breaking_news.summary: A proposed class action claims the firm hid the impact of slowing PC sales from shareholders.
